name: Technogym
verdict: Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund sits at the head of the control structure of NIF Holding (Italy) S.r.l., which holds 6% of Technogym. On hold for a maintainer; the pull request proposes concern.
note: Rating note: on hold for a maintainer; the pull request proposes concern.
